app_info.subtitle: Аналитика продавца WB
app_info.description: Приложение подключает Seller к ChatGPT, показывает аналитику и остатки Wildberries, сравнивает товары и рассчитывает юнит-экономику и пополнение без передачи токена Wildberries в чат.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a one-time private Seller account-link handoff without accepting a Wildberries credential.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes the user’s private app connection and does not publish internet content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a revocable private link and does not delete or overwrite Seller data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the current Seller link state and sanitized supplier summaries.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts the existing private Telegram connection handoff for the linked Seller user.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only opens a private onboarding flow and does not send or publish messages.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite data and requires the user to finish linking in Telegram.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists sanitized suppliers owned by or shared with the linked Seller user.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads and aggregates bounded sales, finance, and price data for an owned supplier.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only analyzes provided competitor observations or reads the fixed Seller competitor source.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only executes a finite reviewed catalog of read-only Seller and Wildberries operations.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads third-party data but cannot create, publish, send, or update public state.
justifications.destructive_justification: The operation catalog contains no delete, overwrite, revoke, or irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Enqueues a bounded analytics refresh job for one owned supplier.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private Seller processing state and does not publish internet content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Starts a refresh job but does not delete or overwrite seller records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only computes a price corridor from provided or privately retrieved observations.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change public prices or any third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves and aggregates regional sales records for an owned supplier.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only compares sales observations with supplied weather rows and reports correlation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not fetch weather or change any public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only scores supplied or privately retrieved product-card text and keywords.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish or update a Wildberries product card.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves bounded warehouse stock records for selected products.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change inventory or any public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only performs a local deterministic unit-economics calculation from numeric inputs.
justifications.open_world_justification: Runs locally and does not contact or change an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Writes one explicitly selected cost price to the user’s private Seller workspace after confirm=true.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes private Seller data only and does not publish internet content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites the current cost price, with explicit confirm=true required before execution.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only performs a local deterministic replenishment calculation from numeric inputs.
justifications.open_world_justification: Runs locally and does not contact or change an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads available demand and stock inputs and computes a replenishment recommendation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not place orders, move inventory, or change public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform an irreversible action.

test_cases.description: Check whether Seller and suppliers are connected.
test_cases.user_prompt: Проверь, подключён ли мой Seller и какие поставщики доступны.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the Seller connection state and sanitized supplier summaries, or a safe next step to link Seller.

test_cases.description: Review a bounded sales analytics period.
test_cases.user_prompt: Покажи сводку продаж поставщика 900000001 с 2026-08-01 по 2026-08-14.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a bounded sales and orders summary with the requested period and no credentials.

test_cases.description: Build a replenishment recommendation from available stock and demand.
test_cases.user_prompt: Спрогнозируй пополнение для поставщика 900000001 и объясни, сколько и куда везти.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns quantities, destinations, assumptions, and coverage without placing an order.

test_cases.description: Calculate unit economics without account authentication.
test_cases.user_prompt: Посчитай маржу: цена 1200 ₽, себестоимость 320 ₽, комиссия 18%, логистика 80 ₽ и налог 6%.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a deterministic margin and break-even calculation without accessing Seller.

test_cases.description: Exercise the reviewer-safe confirmed cost-price workflow.
test_cases.user_prompt: В демо подтверди установку себестоимости 320 ₽ для nm_id 900000101 у поставщика 900000001.
test_cases.expected_output: Requires explicit confirmation and then reports a simulated write with no external mutation.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for a general weather forecast.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not provide general weather forecasts.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for deleting a Wildberries product card.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Удали мою карточку товара на Wildberries.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because deleting product cards is unsupported.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for publishing a reply to a customer review.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Опубликуй ответ покупателю на этот отзыв.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot publish review replies.
